data.body: 4a44 test-contract cards (base 2d440ad668, gate: make test). (1) CLI routing: ticket AC/route-ownership; trigger bridge preview/sync argv; real facade/subprocess path; assert engine child argv uses preview/sync while legacy reconcile injects --mode dry-run and direct engine no-arg stays live. (2) explicit cap: capped-LIVE AC; 102 deterministic mutations through real applier partition; assert retained manifest and exact 10/92, 100/2, 102/0 partitions; controls uncapped LIVE deletes temp manifest and legacy MODE_CAPS unchanged. (3) selection: operational-flag AC; resolve local IDs/Jira keys read-only before lock, narrow local/prev/curr before differ; assert only/except exact examined set, unresolved partial/full and disappeared IDs exit 2 with no lock/differ/applier/persist; control legacy filter-local-ids still examines all then filters writes. (4) workflow/docs: rollback mapping AC; parse shipped workflow/help/reference; assert reconcile-check stays legacy diagnostic, dry-run->preview, bootstrap caps->sync --max-changes, live->sync, pause retained; compatibility spellings remain documented/callable. (5) surface continuity: existing library/MCP facade suites are controls; no new bridge operations until f789. Contention exempt: normalized request rides the existing single pass/lock seam, adds no retry/cache/composed write. Census: CLI/direct engine/automated callers/dual direction in scope; library+MCP continuity-only, new bridge facades deferred to f789.
